title: Artists are lawyering up against AI slop, and some are even winning
summary: In the filing, Google claims that the YouTube terms of service give it broad rights to “reproduce, distribute, [and] prepare derivative works.” “It’s pure bait and switch,” Kogon says, noting that YouTube regularly changes its terms of service.
